description_en: Retrieves a list of sharing rules for a data source
description_zh: 查询某个数据源配置的规则列表
name: ListDataSourceSharedRules

parameters.help_zh: 数据源ID，数据源的唯一标识符
parameters.name: data_source_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the workspace to which the data source is shared. You cannot share the data source to the workspace with which the data source is associated
parameters.help_zh: 数据源分享到的目标项目空间ID，不支持分享到本项目
parameters.name: target_project_id

DataSourceSharedRules.description_en: The sharing rules of the data source
DataSourceSharedRules.description_zh: 数据源的分享规则列表

items.description_en: The sharing rule of the data source
items.description_zh: 数据源分享规则的详细信息

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the rule was created. This value is a UNIX timestamp
CreateTime.description_zh: 数据源分享规则的创建时间（时间戳）

CreateUser.description_en: The ID of the user who creates the rule
CreateUser.description_zh: 数据源分享规则的创建者ID

DataSourceId.description_en: The data source ID. You can call the [ListDataSources]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/211431.html） operation to query the ID
DataSourceId.description_zh: 数据源ID，您可以调用[ListDataSources]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/211431.html）获取数据源的ID

EnvType.description_en:
The environment to which the target data source belongs. The values are as follows:

Dev: the development environment.

Prod: the production environment
EnvType.description_zh:
目标数据源所属的环境。取值如下：
Dev：开发环境。
Prod：生产环境

Id.description_zh: 数据源分享规则的ID，数据源分享规则的唯一标识符

SharedDataSourceName.description_en: The name of the data source in the destination workspace
SharedDataSourceName.description_zh: 分享后在目标项目空间的数据源名称

SharedUser.description_en: The user in the workspace to which the data source is shared. If the data source is shared to the entire workspace, this parameter is left empty
SharedUser.description_zh: 数据源分享到目标项目空间下的用户。若分享到整个项目，则该字段为空

SourceProjectId.description_en: The ID of the workspace with which the data source is associated

TargetProjectId.description_en: The ID of the workspace to which the data source is shared
TargetProjectId.description_zh: 数据源的目标项目空间ID

RequestId.description_zh: 请求 ID。用于定位日志，排查问题
